بَجْلَةٌ A goodly, or beautiful, from or appearance, figure, person, mien, or external state or condition: (Sh, K:) a pleasing aspect; goodliness, or beauty; grounds of pretension to respect; and excellence; or sharpness, or quickness, of intellect. (TA.) You say, إِنَّهُ لَذُو بَجْلَةٍ [Verily he has a goodly, or beautiful, form &c.]. (Sh, TA.) [See the end of the next preceding paragraph.] ―
-b2- A small tree: pl. بَجَلَاتٌ. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
